'''The Introduction''' is a short film, created with ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''{{'}} video engine, and serves as a prequel to ''GTA San Andreas'' that shows the events that happen prior to the events of the game. It was available with the American [[PlayStation 2]] Special Edition of ''GTA San Andreas'' and the ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: Official Soundtrack]]'' compilation. It is set in [[1992]], and ends directly at the beginning of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas'', with [[Sweet Johnson]] informing his brother, [[Carl Johnson]], over telephone that their mother, [[Beverly Johnson|Beverly]], is dead.

The video can be watched and freely downloaded on [http://www.rockstargames.com/videos/video/10491 Rockstar Games' official website] in .wmv or Quicktime format, or on [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=daw8xhaGj2s their official YouTube account].

==Scenes==
===Frank Tenpenny and Eddie Pulaski ===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS1-Tenpenny&Pulaski.jpg|thumb|250px|Tenpenny and Pulaski discussing Smoke's betrayal.]] This opening scene features [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|LSPD]] Officers [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski]] having just come from a meeting with an unnamed individual who Tenpenny refers to as "that fat fuck" and "that over-sized asshole". This could refer to either [[Big Smoke]], who lived in [[Ganton]] prior to the events of GTA San Andreas, or [[Big Bear]], whose former residence was the [[Ganton Courts]] shown in the [[Cutscenes|cutscene]]. Pulaski asks Tenpenny what they are going to do about the new LSPD officer, [[Jimmy Hernandez|Hernandez]], coming on board with them. Tenpenny states that he is not worried about Hernandez, but says another LSPD officer, [[Ralph Pendelbury|Pendelbury]], is a bigger concern to their operation. Tenpenny states that if Pendelbury does what he is threatening to do, then they will have a bigger problem with him.

===The Ballas===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS2-Ballas.jpg|left|thumb|250px|The Ballas discussing Smoke's betrayal.]]
As Tenpenny and Pulaski drive off, a scene shows three [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] members in an alleyway. One of them states that the [[Grove Street Families]] will soon be over, while the Balla member wearing the black jacket expresses concern on whether or not they can trust one of the betraying members of Grove Street, worrying that it may be a trap. The third Balla gang member says that things change, and money changes people.

{{clr}}
===Big Smoke and Ryder===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS3-Smoke&Ryder.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Smoke convinces Ryder to betray the Grove Street Families.]]
The next scene shows Grove Street members Big Smoke and [[Ryder]] talking in the kitchen of [[Ryder's House|Ryder's house]]. Smoke tries to get Ryder on board while Ryder says that he needs to be in charge of his destiny. Smoke states that he has Ryder's back and that they have no choice, and have nothing to feel bad about. Ryder accepts Smoke's offer.

{{clr}}
===Mike Toreno and T-Bone Mendez ===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS4-TBone&Toreno.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mike Toreno receives a phone call from a [[Big Smoke|buyer]] while T-Bone Mendez beats a gang member to death for snitching.]]
The next scene is in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]], which shows a man named [[T-Bone Mendez|Mendez]] brutally assaulting [[Jose (GTA San Andreas)]], which is stopped by another man named [[Mike Toreno|Toreno]]. Toreno tells Mendez that he has found [[Big Smoke|a buyer]] in Los Santos. Toreno then receives a phone call while Mendez continues to beat [[Jose (GTA San Andreas)]] to death against a shipping container for snitching. Toreno tells Mendez that they need to be more productive and that he has a connection in Panama that can supply them with as much product as they need. Both men leave the scene as Mendez drags the body of [[Jose (GTA San Andreas)]] away.

{{clr}}
===Sweet, Smoke and OG Loc===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS5-SweetSmoke&OGLoc.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Sweet and Smoke discussing about CJ.]]
The next scene shows Smoke and Sweet playing dice in the street with some Grove Street gang members. Smoke tries to tell Sweet that they're losing the streets, to which Sweet replies that they are standing by their principles. Smoke goes on about how Grove Street is getting weaker, while the Ballas are getting stronger. Just then, Sweet and Smoke's gangster wannabe friend [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|Jeffrey]] interrupts. Jeffrey states that he wants to be called "OG Loc" because it's a more gangster-sounding name. Sweet tells Jeffrey that he has not put in any work for the set and despite being a friend, he is not a gangster, much to the chagrin of Jeffrey. Sweet and Smoke tell him to go to college and make something of himself. He says to Jeffrey; that Smoke and himself messed their lives up by getting caught in the gang life. Jeffrey leaves as Smoke goes on about a money making opportunity, to which Sweet expresses no interest and states that he is strictly in it for "the hood". Smoke then asks Sweet if he has heard from CJ lately. Sweet says that they aren't speaking. Smoke brings up their late brother [[Brian Johnson|Brian]]. Sweet says that he lost two brothers. One of them got killed, and that the other is running around on the East Coast like a fool.

===CJ and Joey===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS6-LibertyCity.jpg|left|thumb|250px|CJ stealing the car for Joey Leone.]] The next scene shows CJ walking in the streets of [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]] in the [[Red Light District]], near [[Luigi's Sex Club 7]], looking for cars to steal. He initially has no luck as the cars parked along the sidewalk are all locked, but eventually he sneaks up and carjacks a random [[pedestrian|person]] at the traffic lights. CJ speeds away and calls a guy named [[Joey Leone|Joey]], letting him know that he has the [[Washington|car]] he was looking for.

CJ says that he never knew his [[Carl Johnson's Father|father]] and that his brother used to make his life hell. CJ then says that he needs to get the car off the streets, possibly knowing that the [[Liberty City Police Department (3D Universe)|LCPD]] would be looking for it. After a brief conversation, CJ hangs up the phone and drives off.

===Salvatore and Johnny Sindacco===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS7-SalvatoreLeone.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Salvatore Leone and Johnny Sindacco discussing casino plans between the Leones and the Sindaccos.]]
The next scene shows [[Salvatore Leone]] talking to [[Johnny Sindacco]] in [[Salvatore's Gentlemen's Club|Salvatore's home]] in the [[Saint Mark's]] district of Liberty City. Johnny wants Salvatore to invest $5,000,000 in the Sindaccos' [[Caligula's Casino|casino]]. Johnny then tells Salvatore that his father wants to unite the [[Sindacco Crime Family|Sindaccos]] and [[Leone Crime Family|Leones]]. Salvatore brings up Johnny's associates "whacking" his cousin. Salvatore says that he wants to see past it all and states that business is business. Salvatore accuses Johnny of trying to take advantage and treat him like an idiot. Johnny apologizes, and Salvatore says that he will invest the $5,000,000 if he gets control of the books. Johnny states that he can't do that, which angers Salvatore. Salvatore then requests that they bring in a third party to run the place while they "run him". Johnny states that they already have [[Mickey (GTA San Andreas)|a guy]] running it, to which Salvatore tells Johnny to get rid of him.

===Ken Rosenberg ===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS8-KenRosenberg.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Ken Rosenberg walking out of Fort Carson Medical Center.]]
The next scene cuts to [[Fort Carson (3D Universe)|Fort Carson]] and shows [[Ken Rosenberg]] walking out of [[Fort Carson Medical Center]]. Ken is shown talking to himself saying that [[Cocaine|coke]] is for the weak and he is in control of his own destiny. He goes on wallowing, expressing that he was disbarred from the law and needs a job<ref name="Ken Rosenberg disbarrment">{{Quote|(sighs)  I need a job.  I've been disbarred from the law.|Ken Rosenberg during '''The Introduction'''}}</ref>; but then celebrates being clean while attempting to hitchhike.

{{clr}}

===Tenpenny and Pulaski===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS9-Tenpenny&Pulaski.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Tenpenny threatens someone on the phone.]]
The next scene cuts back to [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] and sees Officer Tenpenny on the phone, while Officer Pulaski walks out of the doughnut shop. Tenpenny tells the individual to not to step in his way. Tenpenny goes on about how he's trying to set up this individual for life. Tenpenny also threatens the individual and says that maybe he should kill him since he is no use to him. He then orders Pulaski to organize a hit squad. Tenpenny then orders the individual to do what they agreed to do this week and warns them not to put one over on him, before hanging up on him. Tenpenny then gets annoyed at Pulaski for referring to him as "pal" and reminds him that he is his superior officer. Tenpenny and Pulaski then get in the police car to go and pick Hernandez up.

{{clr}}
===The Green Sabre ===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS10-GreenSabre.jpg|left|thumb|250px|The green Sabre pulling out of a garage.]]
The next quick scene shows a green [[Sabre]] pulling out of a garage and driving slowly down the street.

{{clr}}
===Ken Rosenberg and Tommy Vercetti===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS11-KenRosenberg.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Ken Rosenberg trying to call Tommy Vercetti.]]
Ken Rosenberg is shown talking on a payphone asking to speak with [[Tommy Vercetti]]. Rosenberg argues with someone over the phone for refusing to put him through to Tommy, stating that he made him who he was. The phone hangs up and Ken slams the receiver down.

{{clr}}
=== Kent Paul and Maccer===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS12-KentPaul&Maccer.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Kent Paul announces to Maccer that he is the new manager of the Gurning Chimps.]]
The next scene cuts to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salford Salford], {{WP|England}}, which sees [[Kent Paul]] and [[Maccer]] in a recording studio. Paul announces to Maccer that he is the new manager of [[The Gurning Chimps (3D Universe)|The Gurning Chimps]].

The two then share a hug to celebrate. Maccer then expresses his excitement about visiting [[United States of America|America]].

{{clr}}
===Liberty City===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS13-LibertyCity.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Carl robbing a pedestrian.]]
The video cuts back to Liberty City and shows Carl walking down an alleyway. He passes a random man and then pulls out a gun. He shoves the man up against the wall and demands the man give him money. The man gives Carl everything he has, and he pistol whips the man before leaving.

{{clr}}
===The Sindaccos===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS14-Sindaccos.jpg|left|thumb|250px|The Sindaccos burying Mickey's body in the desert.]]
The next scene cuts to [[Bone County (3D Universe)|Bone County]], where we see two unknown Sindacco Crime Family members in the desert, with one of them digging a grave for Mickey, who is now deceased. The [[Mafia Goon 1|other member]] asks him how his wife is doing, to which the man digging responds that all his wife wants to do is spend money ever since they moved to [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]]. He then asks why they had to kill Mickey. The other Sindacco member stated that it was because he was declaring too much money, and that he heard the Leones are lending them money, so they killed Mickey in exchange. After a brief conversation, the two Sindacco Crime Family members bury Mickey.

===Salvatore Leone and Johnny Sindacco ===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS15-SalvatoreLeone.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Salvatore says that the deal is on.]]
The next scene shows Johnny Sindacco back in Salvatore Leone's home telling him that his boys killed Mickey, to which Salvatore says that the deal is on. Johnny asks Salvatore who they will get to run the casino. Salvatore mentions that there is a [[Ken Rosenberg|lawyer]] who used to work for the [[Forelli Crime Family|Forellis]] who is need of work. Salvatore mentions that the lawyer just got out of rehab, and says that he'll call him.

{{clr}}
=== The Green Sabre===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS16-GreenSabre.jpg|left|thumb|250px|The green Sabre.]]
The green Sabre is once again shown driving down an alleyway in [[Willowfield]].

{{clr}}

===C.R.A.S.H.===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS17-JimmyHernandez.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Officer Jimmy Hernandez joins C.R.A.S.H.]]
The next scene shows Tenpenny and Pulaski picking up Officer Hernandez from the [[Los Santos Police Headquarters]]. Hernandez tells them that he joined [[C.R.A.S.H.]] to put an end to gang crime after working on the streets for [[1989|3 years]]. Hernandez tells the story of a dispute case he was on, with a twenty-year-old hitting his wife who was letting her kids starve. Hernandez says that he was at a dilemma to either let the man walk free from beating his wife, or take the man in and leaving the kids with a drug addict for a mother in the meantime. Pulaski pulls over on orders from Tenpenny, who mentions that he has worked with drug dealers, gang bangers who are not afraid to kill their families. Tenpenny questions whether he can trust Hernandez because he gets easily confused. Hernandez agrees to do whatever it takes to make it. Tenpenny and Pulaski tell him that there will be times where they need to let a bad guy go or look the other way. He then orders Hernandez to get out of the car, which he does.

===The Green Sabre===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS18-GreenSabre.jpg|left|thumb|250px|The green Sabre going towards Grove Street.]]
The green Sabre is shown for a third time driving down the street in the [[Ganton]] area towards [[Grove Street (3D Universe)|Grove Street]].

{{clr}}
===Salvatore Leone and Ken Rosenberg===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS19-CaligulasCasino.jpg|right|thumb|250px|''"I'm the job. Me and my money, and I want it back, I want it back, fast!"'']]
The next scene cuts back to Las Venturas and goes past the casinos in the area. Ken Rosenberg is seen sitting back in the casino office just as Salvatore Leone and a gang member walk in. Salvatore starts getting angry at Ken for sitting around. Salvatore puts a gun to Ken's head and tells him that he wants his money that he invested into the casino back. Salvatore demands Ken get the money fast as Ken fears for his life. Salvatore then tells him to have some fun, and then orders Ken to go get him a drink.

{{clr}}
===Tenpenny, Pulaski, Hernandez and Pendelbury===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS20-RalphPendelbury.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Hernandez about to kill Pendelbury under Tenpenny's threat.]]
The next scene shows Pulaski kicking a grounded Pendelbury, who is being assaulted for threatening to expose Tenpenny and Pulaski's illegal activities to [[Internal Affairs Division (3D Universe)|Internal Affairs]]. Tenpenny orders Hernandez over to him. Tenpenny picks up a gun and then orders Hernandez to shoot Pendelbury. Hernandez pleads with Tenpenny not to make him do it. Tenpenny questions Hernandez's loyalty and asks him whose side he's on. Hernandez says he's on Tenpenny's side, to which Tenpenny tells him to be a man. Tenpenny then tells Hernandez that it's either kill or be killed. Hernandez grabs the gun and walks over to Pendelbury. Pulaski orders him to pull the trigger. Hernandez hesitates, but finally shoots Pendelbury, killing him, and ensuring Tenpenny and Pulaski are able to continue their corrupt acts.

{{clr}}
===The Green Sabre drive-by, CJ, Sweet and Kendl ===
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS21-DriveBy.jpg|thumb|250px|The green Sabre reaches the Johnson House and a member of the Ballas opens fire on the house, before the car speeds off.]]
The last scene shows the green Sabre being driven down Grove Street. When the Sabre reaches the [[Johnson House]], a member of the Ballas opens fire on the house, before the car speeds off. A Grove Street Families homie fires on the car, trying to get revenge, but fails to stop the Ballas from escaping into the night. Sweet rushes inside the house to find his mother dead from the shooting. He then rushes back out to stop [[Kendl Johnson|Kendl]] from entering the house and seeing the carnage.

{{clr}}
[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS22-SweetCallsCJ.jpg|left|thumb|250px|Sweet calls Carl informing him that his mother is dead.]]
The next part of the scene shows Kendl sitting on the front steps of the house weeping as sirens are heard approaching the Grove Street cul-de-sac while Sweet calls Carl to inform him to come home and explains to him that their mother is dead. The final shot sees Carl sitting behind the wheel of a car after hearing about his mother's death, unable to believe he's lost another family member.

A caption reading 'Welcome to San Andreas' appears as the video ends.

{{Clr}}
==Deaths == 
*[[Mickey (GTA San Andreas)|Mickey]] - Killed by a member of the Sindacco Family to get investments for [[Caligula's Casino]].
*[[Ralph Pendelbury]] - Killed by Jimmy Hernandez under Tenpenny's threat.
*[[Beverly Johnson]] - Killed by members of the Ballas gang in an attempt to kill Sweet.
*Unknown Person - Killed by [[T-Bone Mendez]], possibly for snitching.

==Trivia==
*Almost all the scenes were made in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas'' locations (including the Liberty City map from the Saint Mark's Bistro mission) despite the fact they are meant to be somewhere else. For example, Kent Paul's studio in England is actually the interior of [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg's]] [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]]. And despite the fact that Liberty City exteriors were available, as demonstrated earlier in the film, the final scene instead takes place in [[Downtown Los Santos (3D Universe)|Downtown Los Santos]].
*One of the possible reasons Tommy Vercetti does not speak in this short film is that [[Ray Liotta]], the voice actor of Tommy, had a dispute with [[Rockstar North]] about how much "effort" he put into ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]''.
*The appearance of Sex Club 7 in the Liberty City scene is a canonical error. Before [[1998]], Sex Club 7's unit was actually [[Paulie's Revue Bar]]. This happened because Rockstar wrote ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]'' after ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, ''although Rockstar later retconned this mistake.
*In the Mike Toreno scene, T-Bone is seen beating up a snitching gang member. The person, although bleeding heavily, appears to look like [[Jose (GTA San Andreas)|Jose]] from the mission [[Cesar Vialpando (mission)|Cesar Vialpando]]. The white V-neck shirt (although covered in blood) and bald head give off a possible hint.
*[[Sonny Forelli]] is mentioned by Salvatore Leone when he berates Johnny Sindacco; "Ever since Sonny Forelli [[Keep Your Friends Close...|got himself pasted all over Florida]], you think you run things in this town."
*The drive-by scene is inspired by the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BFLvJirYjsg final scene] of the movie ''[[wp:Menace II Society|Menace II Society]]''.
*Salvatore Leone wears different suits for Liberty City and Las Venturas. In Liberty City, he wears a suit exclusively for "The Introduction", and in Las Venturas, he wears the suit seen in mission cutscenes.
*During the part when Carl drives off with the Washington and then camera switches to an interior view, grass can be spotted on the [[Subway in GTA III|elevated subway]]. Also, a unique stunt ramp can be spotted from ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]''.
*The second segment of the Green Sabre shows the vehicle driving out from [[Emmet's]] into a dead-end where the [[Willowfield Safehouse]] is located.
*The location where the Sindacco members bury Mickey is close to the main public road in [[Arco del Oeste]].
*The song playing during the cutscene with Paul and Maccer inside the recording studio is "{{WP|Break 4 Love}}" by {{WP|Raze (group)|Raze}}, which can be heard on [[SF-UR]].
